source.stem:
A helicopter takes off from the ground and rises vertically. It then hovers at a constant height above the ground.
Which sequence of energy changes takes place during the gain in height?

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Groundwater decreases whenever water is extracted, even if seepage replaces all the water removed.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Water in saturated soil pores is not groundwater; only underground lakes count.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Groundwater cannot decrease while the ground looks wet.

intelligence.enrichment: Groundwater is not unlimited; excessive groundwater extraction, decreased vegetation cover, and increased concrete surfaces reduce groundwater availability and make water conservation necessary. Greater withdrawal and reduced replenishment lower available groundwater, which can create water scarcity and lead people to develop conservation methods. The learner correctly applies this rule: Groundwater is not unlimited; excessive groundwater extraction, decreased vegetation cover, and increased concrete surfaces reduce groundwater availability and make water conservation necessary. Groundwater is an endless underground store, so wells cannot reduce it and conservation is unnecessary.
